## Setup (2 min)

**1. Create a free account**
Go to app.hiway2llm.com/auth

**2. Generate an API key**
Settings > API Keys > New key (format: hw_live_...)

**3. Add credentials in n8n**
Click the HiWay2LLM node > Credentials > New > paste your key

Then click Test workflow!

## Output fields

- text: the model response
- model: model actually used
- finish_reason: why generation stopped
- usage.total_tokens: tokens consumed

Tip: enable Return Full Response in options to get the raw OpenAI-format object.
